# BC Hip Hop

> BC Hip Hop is a small online shop in Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada that sells practice floors and cypher gear for breakers and dance crews. It ships across Canada only.

## What it sells (prices in Canadian dollars)
- Roll-out breaking floor, 2 × 2 m: C$189
- Interlocking floor panels, pack of 4: C$149
- Cypher circle floor, 3 m: C$329
- Floor carry bag: C$45
- Headspin beanie: C$32
- Floor cleaning kit: C$24

## How ordering works
- The order form at https://bchiphopnetwork.com/order-a-floor.html sends a request; nothing is charged on the site.
- A person replies by e-mail within one working day with the total and a secure payment link.
- Original Delivery is the standard tracked service, charged once per order by region (C$25 within British Columbia, 3-6 working days after dispatch).
- A Rocket Pool is a crew order: one floor shared by several dancers, with the total split into equal shares.
- Unused items can be returned within 30 days of delivery.

## Pages
- https://bchiphopnetwork.com/ : home
- https://bchiphopnetwork.com/breaking-floors.html : roll-out floor, interlocking panels, cypher circle; sizes, surface, weight, prices
- https://bchiphopnetwork.com/cypher-gear.html : carry bag, headspin beanie, floor cleaning kit; floor-care routine
- https://bchiphopnetwork.com/floor-planner.html : floor planner (crew size, space, style) and the rules it uses
- https://bchiphopnetwork.com/order-a-floor.html : order form with running total
- https://bchiphopnetwork.com/about-bc-hip-hop.html : about the shop
- https://bchiphopnetwork.com/shipping-across-canada.html : delivery costs and times by region
- https://bchiphopnetwork.com/returns-and-refunds.html : returns and refunds
- https://bchiphopnetwork.com/privacy.html and https://bchiphopnetwork.com/terms.html

## What it does not do
- No classes or lessons
- No battles or events
- No music or beats for sale
- No shipping outside Canada

Contact: crew@bchiphopnetwork.com
